messages:
Elaine (Design): hey team — dropping a quick mock for the latency dashboard tweaks i sketched this morning. main asks: make the timeflow scrubber keyboard-first, clarify sampling microcopy, and make p95 pill stick when you scrub across heatmap. https://figma.com/... :eyes:
Jordan (PM): digging the direction. question: what's the expected default sampling when range > 24h? currently product set is 10% but we could show 'sampling applied' CTA instead of changing the visual weight on metrics.
Sam (Eng): 10% default sounds fine. implementation note: live scrubbing over heatmap currently triggers heavy queries. we should debounce to 120ms and avoid full KV-cache misses for short jumps. pseudo: `q?start=...&end=...&sampling=0.1&debounce=120`
Miguel (SRE): agree on debounce. also watch out for bucket-edge jitter — when scrub jumps across bucket boundaries the p95 can hop. suggestion: apply a tiny smoothing window (2s) client-side for the immediate visualization to avoid perceived flakiness.
Clara (A11y): a few a11y nits:
- the scrubber must be a real slider with role="slider" and keyboard support for arrow keys + pageup/pagedown. announce `aria-valuetext` as "time range: 03:12 to 03:42"
- when sampling is changed show an `aria-live=polite` message "Sampling set to 10%, results omitted for some requests"
- heatmap colors: the orange -> red step doesn't meet 4.5:1 for small deltas. consider using a sequential palette with higher contrast or an optional patterned overlay for colorblind users.
Elaine (Design): good calls. for microcopy i was thinking: the slider label could read `Sampling rate (applied to long ranges)` vs `Sample rate` — which is clearer? also thinking of a tiny badge next to p95 that says `sampled` when sampling>0.
Jordan (PM): prefer "Sampling rate" short. but add a hover tooltip: "Only applied to requests spanning > 24h or > 1M rows" so it's discoverable. badge: yes, useful for signal.
Sam (Eng): micro-implementation: badge toggles client-side, backend returns `meta.sampled=true` in telemetry so we can surface it without extra query.
Miguel (SRE): add metric `visualization.sampling_applied` to telemetry so ops can filter incidents where sampling masked regressions.
Clara (A11y): one more — keyboard focus order must prioritize scrubber -> time presets -> sampling slider -> p95 pill. make the p95 pill reachable and announce its value change with `aria-live` when focus lands.
design-bot: created PR #4823 for accessible scrubber focus, assigned to @Sam and @Clara :robot_face:
Elaine (Design): updated Figma with the badge + tooltip + accessible scrubber states. please comment on the copy for the tooltip (i put: "Sampling is applied to long ranges to reduce query cost; results may be approximate").
Jordan (PM): tweak: "Sampling reduces query cost for large ranges; results are approximate" — shorter.
Sam (Eng): thumbs up. I'll implement the debounce + badge flag. can we agree on debounce 120ms and smoothing 2s?
Miguel (SRE): +1 for 120ms and 2s smoothing. also document fallback: if smoothing is on and user toggles smoothing off in devtools, we should still surface raw values via a hidden toggle.
Clara (A11y): confirmed. i'll add the aria attributes and test keyboard nav. i'll also test with VoiceOver + NVDA on the new scrubber.
Elaine (Design): excellent. next steps: Sam implements PR, Clara reviews a11y, Miguel adds telemetry, Jordan approves copy, i'll close the loop in Figma. thanks all :heart:
